name: Virtual private network (VPN)
short_description: A virtual private network (VPN) creates an encrypted tunnel from a remote device into a private network over an untrusted network such as the internet, traditionally used for remote access to company resources.

evidence.quote: So you start the old VPN, wait for it to connect
and maybe a VPN when they work from home
When was the last time you actually enjoyed connecting to a VPN?
Is it just a fancy VPN or is it something completely different?
A VPN uses the public internet. Your data is encrypted so it's secure and transit.
